AI Researcher Quits Over Existential Risk Concerns

An Anthropic researcher has resigned from the artificial intelligence company, citing fears that AI development is proceeding too rapidly and poses existential risks. The researcher expressed concerns that both Anthropic and OpenAI are "gambling with our lives" due to the uncontrolled advancement of AI. The individual reportedly quit due to these profound anxieties about the future trajectory of AI technology.
